svg.title: Mesoamerica & the Caribbean
svg.desc: Selected, sourced connections. Arrows label unions, divisions, conquest, independence, changes in rule, and contact. Node positions do not measure time or ancestry. Artistic exchange, living Maya communities, conquest in central Mexico and Haiti’s anti-slavery revolution. Separate branches do not imply one regional empire. Select a node for Wikipedia or an arrow for its sources.
svg.text: Tap a node to read · Tap an arrow for the event and sources
